method: 内置 image_gen，以善功堂实机截图作为风格参照生成新构图
output: 善功堂风格_种植面板_理想图_v8.png
user_requirements: 按善功堂的风格重新出一张种植面板理想图
看清地块环境、灵草需求和添加材料操作
不照搬背景，只需要风格
style_transferred: 灰褐哑光木框的厚度、连接与层次
暖米白纸面和少量灰蓝细节、淡山水压边
普通楷体、深墨文字、克制松灰绿与纸面按钮
composition: 全新矩形近全屏木框；左单地正俯视田面，右需求对照与原因，下方材料选择、预览和确认。
scope: 理想图与现有策划界面说明；需求为定性排版示例，未定材料、作用、用量、费用或新物品；没有修改游戏代码或存档。
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Deliver ONE complete high-fidelity Chinese cultivation-game planting management UI, landscape 16:9, desktop, exceptionally crisp readable Chinese. This is the next screen in the same game as the attached ACTUAL 善功堂 screenshot.

IMAGE 1 ROLE: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Learn the reference's connected desaturated grey-brown timber UI frames with shallow believable thickness, blue-grey mineral colors, warm ivory paper insets, sparse pale blue-grey landscape wash at paper corners, dark ordinary Chinese Kaiti/slab gameplay text, restrained pine-grey-green selection, matte broad hand-painted pigment shapes and quiet corner ornament. Do NOT copy its background or composition.
The user explicitly said “不要照搬背景，我只是需要这种风格”.
Create an ORIGINAL planting-page frame and composition. DO NOT reproduce the shop building/pavilion, roof tiles, eaves, floral sprays, peak emblem, hanging signs, tassels, exchange counter, four product columns or shop labels. Do not put farming inside a shop or room. Do not paste the shop screenshot. No architecture, landscape vista or furnishings as a backdrop. Quiet neutral blue-grey margin only.

STYLE REQUIREMENTS:
This must have the reference's crafted wood-and-paper FUNCTIONAL UI structure and material depth, not merely several flat paper rectangles. A single shallow connected grey-brown timber outer rim, internal timber rails and warm paper inset panels. At corners, a few restrained simple joined wooden brackets and narrow blue-grey inset details, completely different geometry from the reference roof. Regular clean rectangular silhouette with softened/chamfered joins. Material connections believable, no floating carved parts. Fine grey-brown ruled paper details, no bright gold.
Matte illustrative watercolor/gouache, consistent broad painted shapes, readable restrained texture. No luminous edges, bloom, halos, glitter or fog. No saturated teal banner, bamboo decoration, oversized calligraphic typography, bevelled game gems or fancy app dashboard cards. Match the actual reference's clear modest-sized regular Chinese font and paper-button style.
Do not simplify it back into a grey background with thin ink-only cards: keep timber structural framing, warm paper surfaces and blue-grey details visible.

SINGLE FIELD RULE:
One field is one independent page. Exactly ONE continuous field appears on the screen, strict vertical overhead, no perspective, no character. No multiple fields, no small plot grid, no grid inside the ground. Same initial condition as the wider system's other plots; modifications come from player inputs, no innate spring, shade or rock terrain advantage.
This image shows an unplanted field with no materials yet added. Do not invent already applied improvements or plant damage.

LAYOUT, nearly full-screen usable workspace, modest margins, no large decorative empty header:
1) Top connected shallow timber title strip, ivory center plaque with dark text “灵草种植”. Smaller context “瑶圃峰 · 一号田”. Upper right a framed warm-paper button “返回田地”.
2) Upper approximately 65% of body: LEFT 55% single field and RIGHT 45% environment/plant requirement comparison, separated by one connected slender timber mullion.
3) Lower approximately 28% body: full-width warm-paper material workspace with a timber top rail. All three regions share a coherent frame, not three unrelated floating cards.

UPPER LEFT:
Paper heading “一号田”, small badge “未定植”.
Small view tabs “当前地块” (muted sage selected) and “改造预览”.
Below: ONE rectangular area of actual planting ground seen perfectly straight down, flat matte grey-brown earth washes with a subtle earthen perimeter, sparse soft brush marks, no bright lawn, pebbly photoreal texture, stone border, divided beds, any trees, any ponds or any plants. It is land seen in a management view, not a wooden planter box, not a giant inventory icon.
The paper surround is thin enough for the field to feel usable.
A concise line below: “原有土层：普通土层” and “已加入材料：暂无”.

UPPER RIGHT:
Heading “环境与需求”.
Directly below, a neat compact target selector “目标灵草：月露苔” with a small downward arrow.
Table with four clearly aligned columns:
“条件” | “地块当前” | “灵草需求” | “判定”
Use soft horizontal rules on warm clean paper, no dense heavy cell grid.
Exactly five rows:
“温度” | “偏暖” | “凉润” | “偏高”
“灵力浓度” | “偏低” | “充足” | “不足”
“水分” | “湿润” | “湿润” | “满足”
“光照” | “直射” | “遮阴” | “过强”
“土层” | “普通土层” | “阴湿岩面” | “不符”
Sage checkmark on water and muted dark terracotta crosses on unmet rows, always accompany with words.
Under table a modest ink heading “未满足的原因” and two compact readable lines:
“温度偏暖、灵力不足、光照过强。”
“当前土层不符合灵草需求。”
No numeric temperature, percentage, arbitrary cost, speed, timer or plant yield. “月露苔” is a target before planting, so no stopped/damaged-growth badge.

LOWER WORKSPACE, title “田地改造”:
A compact row of ordinary paper tabs: “添加材料” (selected in subdued sage), “控温”, “水分”, “光照”, “聚灵”.
Below selected 添加材料 tab, show three horizontally arranged functional groups on the same paper inset, separated by subtle lines:
A. Heading “已加入材料”, text “暂无”.
B. Heading “准备加入”, an empty outlined paper item slot with a modest plus sign, next to a clearly actionable paper button “从行囊选择”.
C. Heading “影响预览”, text “选择材料，查看加入后的环境变化。” followed by “逐项对照灵草需求。”
At lower right two restrained DISABLED paper buttons “预览变化” and “确认加入”, showing that no item has been selected yet. Keep readable grey disabled text and proper button boundaries.
This communicates choose an actual item -> preview effects -> confirm addition, without inventing effects.
“添加材料” means adding actual other materials into the EXISTING land, not exchanging entire soil types. DO NOT write 基质 anywhere. No predefined soil kit, no 腐殖/岩质/遗骸 category tabs, no made-up material names, no fake inventory counts, no rock thumbnail that magically solves soil requirements. Future remains are out of this initial empty selection view.

HARD CHECKS: one page for one field; visible actual ground, actual-vs-required environment and clear concrete mismatch reasons, clear add-material operation; warm paper + joined grey-brown wood + blue-grey detail style truly like the shop reference, with an entirely original structure and NO copied shop background/roof. Calm handmade game appearance, not generic fantasy parchment or modern SaaS. All displayed text legible. No developer annotations, no “sample data” tags, no watermark.
